answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Issuance tied to graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 11 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 420 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The rate is earned, not bought, so money cannot shortcut the wait. The island of the design is public, the raven of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the tide of honest work is what finally pays. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
